correctness.rationale: From the source MMCA equations, strict same-sign neighborhood majorities force local clipping to a constant sign and yield the exact disease-free vaccinated state. The full infected block is \((1-\alpha)\mathrm{Id}+\lambda D A\) and the vaccine/opinion eigenvalues are \(1-\phi\), \(-\phi\) and zero. Symmetry plus alpha,phi in (0,1) establishes strict Schur stability precisely when \(\lambda\rho(A[G_-])<\alpha\), and positive Perron invasion otherwise. Each sign class on a connected strict mixed-sign graph needs at least three vertices. Explicit K3-P3 bridge gives exact opposed multipliers \(11/10\) and \(1/2+3\sqrt2/10\) at equal coverage \(1/3\), and K_m-P_m gives ratio \((m-1)/(2\cos(\pi/(m+1)))\to\infty\). Standalone code passed finite checks; no infinite numerical certification is claimed.

value.rationale: The source motivates exactly the tension among social influence, vaccine propensity and epidemic thresholds. The result provides a sharp six-vertex endogenous counterexample to mean-coverage inference on the very same connected contact graph, classifies full local stability, and quantifies an unbounded loss of epidemic-threshold information even when vaccinated share and average opinion match. Its size lower bound and parametric family are structural facts, not arbitrary simulation or restatement of generic spectral heuristics.
